parameters.content:
## Attendance Warning Notifications

The portal POSTs a finalized nested attendance-warning snapshot. The workflow validates and stores the batch, flattens student/course records, compares them with the stored warning state, sends one change notification, logs delivery, and upserts the new state.

Level 3 — Drop uses an urgent red HTML email. Email Test Config can redirect all mail to a controlled recipient.

### Synchronous responses
- 400 invalid payload (accepted:false, error)
- 200 duplicate batch_id (accepted:true, duplicate:true)
- 500 storage failure before acceptance (accepted:false)
- 202 accepted after durable store (accepted:true, duplicate:false)

Invalid payloads never update warning state or send notifications.

## First run

When no warning-state rows exist, the first valid snapshot establishes the baseline and sends no notifications. Later snapshots notify only when a warning level changes, a non-Good course first appears, or a tracked course disappears.
